voice: 眼睛说，读完了。脑子说，你谁？
en: Eyes: finished. Brain: sorry, who are you?

voice: 同一行，读了三遍。第四遍？先别。
en: Same line. Third read. A fourth? Let's try something else.

voice: 选中文字，按下快捷键。让耳朵接个班。
en: Select some text. Press your shortcut. Let your ears take a shift.

voice: 点两下，留出一条阅读带。其他地方，先下班。
en: Two clicks. One reading band. Everything else can clock out.

voice: 小小一个 Mac 应用。系统语音，或者你自己的语音 API。
en: A little Mac app. System voices, or your own speech API.

voice: 代码已经开源。觉得有用，来 GitHub 点颗星。给这位阅读搭子，加个鸡腿。
en: Open source. If it helps, star it on GitHub. A little snack for your reading buddy.
